Name: Passing Greetings
Author: SEDUS69
Description:
[b][color=#00ff00][size=5]Automatically completes the normal daily NPC talk when you walk close to a villager. No button press and no dialogue window: just walk by, and the day's friendship points are awarded.[/size][/color][/b]
[heading][size=5]Features[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*]Completes the daily talk (friendship points and the "talked today" flag) when you come within range of an NPC.[/*]
[*]Triggers once per NPC per day, like vanilla talking.[/*]
[*]Optional speech bubble above the NPC, with configurable text and delay.[/*]
[*]Fully configurable in-game through Generic Mod Config Menu (optional).[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 (1.6.15 or later)[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.5.2 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional, for in-game settings)[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[center][/center]
[list=1]
[*][size=2][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size][/*]
[*][size=2][i](Optional)[/i] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure the mod.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley\Mods.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[/list][heading]Configuration[/heading]
With Generic Mod Config Menu installed, open the mod's settings page from the title screen or the in-game Options menu. Changes apply immediately after saving; no restart is needed.
[table][tr][th]Setting[/th]
[th]Range[/th]
[th]Default[/th]
[th]Description[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Enable automatic daily chat[/td]
[td]on / off[/td]
[td]on[/td]
[td]Turns the feature on or off.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Detection radius[/td]
[td]0.5–10 tiles[/td]
[td]2[/td]
[td]Maximum distance between you and an NPC.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Detection frequency[/td]
[td]1–120 ticks[/td]
[td]15[/td]
[td]How often nearby NPCs are checked. Lower reacts faster but checks more often.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Friendship points per chat[/td]
[td]0–1000[/td]
[td]20[/td]
[td]20 matches vanilla talking. Higher values act as a cheat.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Show NPC response[/td]
[td]on / off[/td]
[td]on[/td]
[td]Shows a speech bubble above the NPC.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]NPC response[/td]
[td]up to 30 characters[/td]
[td]"Hey!"[/td]
[td]Text shown above the NPC. Longer text is shortened when saved.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]NPC response delay[/td]
[td]0–120 ticks[/td]
[td]18[/td]
[td]Delay before the bubble appears. 60 ticks is about one second.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]Editing config.json
[url=https://github.com/Sedus/stardew-passing-greetings/blob/main/README.md#editing-configjson][/url]
Without Generic Mod Config Menu, edit
[code]config.json[/code]in the mod folder (it is created the first time you run the game).
[code]config.json[/code]is read at startup, so restart the game after editing it. Out-of-range values are clamped to the limits above, and the response text is trimmed and shortened to 30 characters.
[heading]How it works[/heading]
[list]
[*]Checks nearby NPCs at the configured interval, using straight-line distance in tiles.[/*]
[*]Only runs while you are free to act: it pauses during menus, events, cutscenes, and minigames.[/*]
[*]Skips hidden NPCs and NPCs you can't normally talk to.[/*]
[*]Ignores NPCs you haven't met yet (no friendship record). Talk to them normally once first.[/*]
[*]Does not open dialogue or simulate dialogue choices. It completes the daily-talk friendship interaction only, so dialogue-based quests and event scripts still need a real conversation.[/*]
[/list][heading]Known limitations[/heading]
[list]
[*]Not tested in multiplayer or split-screen.[/*]
[*]Friendship caps still apply (for example, the cap for NPCs you aren't dating or married to).[/*]
[/list][url=https://github.com/Sedus/stardew-passing-greetings][size=6]GitHub[/size][/url]
